title: Sherpa voice Qwen3-ASR download + bridge roundtrip
description: Downloads the Qwen3-ASR 0.6B int8 model (~614 MB) on-device via __AGENTIC__.downloadModel, polls until status === 'downloaded', then runs the testASR('qwen3') roundtrip. Heavy: budget several minutes for the download per device.

prepare-ready-0.intent: The sherpa-voice app is running with the agentic bridge installed.
